name: Er (Son of Shelah, son of Judah, father of Leka)
title: Descendant of Judah through Shelah
summary: Er was a son of Shelah, who was the third son of the patriarch Judah. Er is mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles as the father of Leka. He is known as part of the tribal history of the tribe of Judah and belonged to the linen workers' clan in Beth-ashbea.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Er is listed as a son of Shelah, son of Judah, in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles. He is mentioned as the father of Leka and linked to the clan of linen workers.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Shelah and their occupations
keyEvents.description: The sons of Shelah, including Er, are associated with specific artisan clans and cities in Judah. They worked with linen and pottery.

keyEvents.title: Shelah's birth as Judah's third son
keyEvents.description: Shelah, Er's father, was born as the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife, the daughter of Shua. Shelah's lineage became important within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The family history of Judah
keyEvents.description: Judah's complex family history, which includes his three sons with the Canaanite woman, forms the background for Er's lineage through Shelah.
